title: Mythic Shulker - Event
description: MysticShulkerEvent is a dynamic, fully configurable server event plugin that spawns a secure, high-tier loot container at a designated location. Administrators can manage the entire event through an intuitive, interactive GUI dashboard in real time.
body:
# **The Ultimate GUI-Driven Mystic Container Event Engine**

ShulkerEvent introduces automated, high-stakes care-package events to your server. It spawns mystic shulker boxes that players must find and crack open using a pickaxe to claim rare loot.

Featuring a 100% in-game GUI dashboard, admins can manage everything live without ever opening a config file.

# **✨ Key Features:**

★ 🛠 Full GUI Admin Dashboard: Create events, bind locations, and edit loot tables directly in-game.

★ 🎨 Skins & Aura Matrices: Seamlessly swap between all 17 shulker variants and cycle live particle effects.
 
★ 💰 Built-in Economy Control: Adjust precise item drop chances and economy-cut rates to keep rewards balanced.
 
★ ⚔ Dynamic PvP Toggle: Set individual event locations to high-risk Warzones or secure Peaceful zones.
 
★ 💥 Implosion Launch Wave: Blast nearby players into the air with adjustable physics when the container fractures.
 
★ ⏳ Hologram & Timer Ready: Integrates instantly with DecentHolograms to track real-time durability and respawn countdowns.

# **🚀 How to Use**

★ Create an Event

Run /se create <name> to register a new mystic container.

★ Open the Dashboard

Type /se or /sevent to open the Master Dashboard, then click your new event to configure it.

★ Bind a Location

Click the Bind Location button in the GUI, close the menu, and Right-Click any block in your world to place the shulker.

★ Setup Loot & Rules

Use the in-game GUI to throw items into the loot matrix, adjust drop chances via Left/Right click, swap skins, toggle PvP zones, or change timers.

★ Crack & Loot

Players with permissions can now strike the shulker with a Pickaxe to break its durability, launch nearby players on fracture, and claim the rewards!
